chunks: And all that they had done (for security) availed them nothing.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that our deeds availed us nothing?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Bara'ah* (disconnection) from worldly attachments, illustrating that mere accumulation of wealth or deeds without *Tawhid* and spiritual sincerity is futile. It serves as a poignant reminder that divine acceptance depends on the quality of faith rather than the quantity of worldly efforts, a theme frequently cited in sermons of Imam Ali regarding the transient nature of material gains.
